ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Government Programs
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of fraud in government programs, including housing and nutrition programs, and track the flow of taxpayer dollars.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records investigation
questions: What is the total amount of taxpayer dollars lost to fraud in government programs?
Which programs are most vulnerable to fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread abuse of taxpayer dollars and hold government agencies accountable for their handling of funds. I recommend starting with a data analysis of government program expenditures and tracking the flow of funds to identify potential red flags.
